# dude & Co.

> Construction material supplier and civil construction contractor based in Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka. Supplies cement, TMT steel, M-sand, aggregates (jelly), red bricks, concrete blocks, AAC blocks, ready mix concrete and interior/finishing materials across Karnataka. Every quotation is itemised for the specific project; no price list is published. GST registered (GSTIN 29AAYFD3535F1Z1).

- Address: No. 20, Saladoddi Grama, Bengaluru Urban - 560082, Karnataka, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 63637 03532
- Service area: Karnataka. Regular deliveries in and around Bengaluru, Mysuru and Tumakuru; project-based supply to other districts.
- Construction: civil construction in Bengaluru and surrounding districts, built to approved drawings, with material supply across Karnataka.

- [M-sand](https://www.dudeandco.in/materials/m-sand): concrete, plastering, washed
- [Aggregates / jelly](https://www.dudeandco.in/materials/aggregates): 12 mm, 20 mm, 40 mm
